question:
**Select the option that gives the most appropriate meaning of the following word.**

Crude
solution:
The correct answer is **"Natural".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] 

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• "**Crude**" means in a natural or raw state; not yet processed or refined (कच्चा).
 
• '**Natural**' refers to something existing in or derived from nature; not made or caused by people (प्राकृतिक).
 
• Hence, the correct meaning is: '**Natural**'.

Therefore the correct answer is **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "**Damp**" means slightly wet. (नम)
 
• "**Refined**" means with impurities or unwanted elements having been removed. (परिष्कृत)
 
• "**Processed**" means having been subjected to a special process or treatment. (प्रक्रिया द्वारा तैयार)
